text:
marie_cs: Quick triage  cohort overflow: 3 orgs accepted, we only have 2 seats. Need reallocation + renewal-signal capture. Tagging @dan_ae @owen_eng @kevin_ops.
dan_ae: Which orgs and any holds?
marie_cs: Orgs: BrightPath (confirmed), SentoHealth (procurement hold), ArcadiaOps (confirmed).
owen_eng: For SentoHealth wait on procurement. We should add a short renewal-intent checkbox to prework so AEs know risk.
kevin_ops: Ops can provision 2 seats now and mark one seat as "hold - procurement" for 48h. I'll also add a PagerDuty rule: if pre-kickoff survey <50% at 36h, AE gets pinged.
marie_cs: Draft outreach (very short): "Hi <Name>  welcome to the pilot. Pick a kickoff slot (Tue 11:00 PDT or Wed 15:00 PDT) and complete this 3-question pre-kickoff survey: https://forms.redwood.example/pilot-prework. We'll provision seats after slot chosen. -Marie"
dan_ae: I'll nudge SentoHealth procurement; if no response in 24h free the seat for waitlist. Also will collect attendee names.
owen_eng: I'll gate the feature flag for confirmed orgs after roster final. Also will add a tiny telemetry label to track pilot traffic.
kevin_ops: Action items: @dan_ae finalize roster by EOD; @owen_eng enable flags after roster; @marie_cs send outreach. Ops will provision once roster final and hold one seat for 48h.
marie_cs: Thanks team :thumbsup: call out any high-risk accounts here (procurement/billing/no-show) and we'll escalate.
pilotbot: Kickoff doc created: https://docs.redwood.example/pilot-overflow-plan (perms: cs, ae, ops).
